executive_summary: On June 24, 2026, OFAC removed 11 entities from the SDN list, all of which were associated with the RUSSIA-EO14024 program. The removed entities include 8 individuals and 3 vessels/entities. No new entities were added to the list. The removals primarily affect Russia and Turkey, with implications for sanctions compliance and risk assessment.
